notes.text: Lists, player names and archetype names copied from mtgtop8, which took them from the organizer's (Card Titan's) Melee page; the lists were not compared card for card against Melee.

Placings and seeds are from the organizer's Melee page: seeds are the standings after the last Swiss round, and placings follow its playoff matches (quarterfinals: Anthony Valentine def. BoshNRoll_Brian 2-0; Peter Coloyan def. Adam Prusa 2-0; Tom Basketball def. Camden Drash 2-0; Brandon Chang def. Dan Nelson 2-0. Semifinals: Anthony Valentine def. Peter Coloyan 2-1; Tom Basketball def. Brandon Chang 2-0. Final: Anthony Valentine def. Tom Basketball 2-0). They agree with mtgtop8's at every tier. Melee's own final standings list the Top 8 in a different, wrong order (Dan Nelson 1st); its match results are what count. Brian Coval played as "BoshNRoll_Brian".
Swiss was played on 2023-12-08; mtgtop8 dates the event to that day. The Top 8 was played on 2023-12-10.
